items.title: Percy Humphrey Band: Percy Humphrey, Jim Robinson, Ernest Roubleau, Josiah Frazier Interview, 1972-02-29
items.q: Sam up there playing the music. I don't know if you're stuck about that. I'm up there watching Alfred on the drum and looking at the band play that number.

ctx.x: When I went over there, ooh, I just went over to the base and looked at all them pretty people past. I said, Jesus Christ, I want to be 21 years old. But I didn't call it. You know what I mean? Mary said, oh, the Lord said, oh, he's a man now. Yeah, he's a boy. Oh, Jesus Christ. I said, I want to go by his daddy and lose some to all the first jobs and playing. I was a young fellow there too, you know. But otherwise, you know, I never let no girls then know. I was busy with music. I didn't like them. And then…

I like one. You see, in my time, I know Jim as old as I am, when we go to the balls, you remember we were talking to the great economy hall. And they like that number stumbling. I'm going to bring you to around 21 and 22. Them numbers come out. We go to them big balls, like the church, you heard the Jim was giving the festival. Sam up there playing the music. I don't know if you're stuck about that. I'm up there watching Alfred on the drum and looking at the band play that number. You understand? And the rest of…
